newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK manufacturers expect more orders in 1997 - poll.
newsitem.headline: HK manufacturers expect more orders in 1997 - poll.

text.p: Hong Kong manufacturers generally expect a slight increase in the volume of orders this year compared to 1996, a government survey showed on Monday.

Makers of electronic and electrical products as well as the printing industry generally expect a minor increase in the volume of orders, the half-yearly business prospects survey conducted by the Census and Statistics Department found.
Makers of apparel and fabricated metal products anticipated a fairly stable volume of orders, while manufacturers in the textiles industry expected a mild decrease, it found.
Construction firms also expected a moderate increase in the volume of construction output in 1997, the survey found.
Exporters expected a moderate increase in the value of both domestic exports and re-exports this year compared with 1996.
The survey covers about 300 firms from major manufacturing industries, the import/export trades, the banking industry and the construction sector.
